subject.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens

question: Is the macOS Swift regression lane sufficient for this signed-app timing change, or must the PR provide a redacted signed-app recording or live diagnostic artifact before merge?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent, but repository policy treats real behavior proof as a merge gate and the contributor states that no visual recording is attached.

options.title: Require signed-app proof
options.body: Request a redacted recording, live output, or linked artifact from a signed macOS app showing both the suppressed and eligible banner states.

options.title: Accept runner proof
options.body: Explicitly override the proof gate based on the macOS Swift lane and focused state-transition regressions.

recommendation.title: Require signed-app proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted recording, live output, or linked artifact from a signed macOS app showing both the suppressed and eligible banner states.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and current implementation trail point to steipete as the strongest available routing candidate, though another qualified macOS reviewer should make the proof decision.
